import PortalLanding from "../../../components/PortalLanding.astro";

When a Software Factory task needs a new agent capability, define the expected output and choose the skill, plugin, or tool that will produce it. If several agents share the work, specify how they hand off each task. Test the **Agent Package** against real scenarios, then publish it as a template your team can install.

To use an existing template, [install it in your workspace](/getting-started/first-employee/). To connect an application through the API or SDK, see [Developer](/developer/).

## Build and configuration reference

<PortalLanding portal="build" section="guides" />

Open **FDE workbench** (`/fde/`) in the console to build and publish. FDE users and administrators can enter the workbench. **Channel configuration** and **Agent tests** require administrator access.
